capabilities: List, create, edit and delete bills in IHateMoney or Cospend projects
Auto-categorize bills from their titles with trainable keyword matching
Show statistics by category, person and month plus a settle-up view
Export filtered or full bill data to PDF and Excel inside the vault
Connect via IHateMoney credentials, Nextcloud login, or a local vault-only project
disambiguation: Not a standalone budgeting app; bills normally live in an IHateMoney or Nextcloud Cospend project, though a serverless local-vault backend is also supported.
extras: Marked beta by the author, who asks users to report bugs on GitHub Issues and provides no warranty; the built-in keyword list for auto-categorization is tuned for German-speaking households. The plugin is flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: IHateMoney has lacked a category field for bills since 2011, so the author added client-side categorization stored in the vault.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to view or edit bills from shared-expense services, and IHateMoney itself has no category field for bills.
